notes.content: [p]Its been a while...[/p][p][/p][p]This update includes a major rework of significant portions of the game. I have taken your comments and feedback into account, holding frequent third party testing to ensure a wider player base can experience the game without interruption stemming from technical non-compliance.[/p][p][/p][p]In other words this means:[/p][list][*][p]Reworked movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked animations (across the board).[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked combat + magic mechanisms.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked all spells.[/p][/*][/list][p]Introduced more complex puzzle solving throughout certain maps.[/p][p][/p][p]Removal of the demo + playtest capability represents a shift in focus towards the final stages of development. This decision was taken as the demo (in its un-updated state) no longer accurately represented the game.[/p][p]Further to this, the game has been delayed several times over the recent months, with the aim of delivering an enjoyable experience, something complicated by the fact I am a single dev.[/p][p][/p][p]Kind regards,[/p][p]OH[/p][p][/p]

Fixes to many aspects of the game as highlighted via playtest and demo comments including:

Removal of damage text artefacts when viewing inventory.
More logging.
Menu Redesign.

notes.title: Playtest Update #2
notes.content:
This build contains improvements and bug fixes highlighted within reviews I have recieved from playtesters. A summary is included below:
- Issues with canvases stacking have been resolved.
- Issues with player movement have been resolved.
- Running, sprinting and attacking on the move.
